name: page_turn
use: Quran, hadith and book readers, mushaf page swipes
prompt: A single paper page of a book turned by hand right at the start, clear crisp close-up rustle and soft flap, loud and present, no hiss, quiet room, no music

name: counter_tick
prompt: One single isolated click of two smooth stone prayer beads touching, then complete silence, one hit only, very close, dry, no reverb, no music

name: counter_round
use: Completing a round of 33 in a tasbih counter
prompt: A few smooth stone prayer beads sliding along a string and settling together, short soft clatter, close up, no music

name: prayer_reminder
description: A gentle stream with a breeze through leaves
use: Salah time reminders, scheduled local notifications
prompt: A gentle flowing stream swelling softly with a light breeze through leaves, calm and peaceful, fades in and out, natural, no music, no voice

name: quran_open
use: Opening the mushaf or a book, starting a reading session
prompt: A heavy hardcover book being opened gently, soft creak of the spine and a light paper flutter, close up, quiet room, no music

name: quran_close
use: Closing the mushaf or a book, ending a reading session
prompt: A hardcover book closed gently, soft muffled paper thump, close up, quiet room, no music

name: bookmark
description: A cloth ribbon laid between pages
use: Bookmarking an ayah, page or hadith
prompt: A satin cloth ribbon pulled firmly across a paper page and laid in a book, clear soft swish, close and present, quiet room, no music

name: prayer_mat
use: Starting a prayer, prayer mode on, marking a prayer as prayed
prompt: A soft woven fabric prayer rug being unrolled and laid flat on a carpet, gentle fabric rustle and soft thump, close up, quiet room, no music

name: qibla_found
description: A clear drop into a deep well
prompt: A single clear water drop falling into a deep stone well, soft natural echo, calm and resolved, no music, no tone

name: dua_complete
description: A long soft breeze through palm leaves
use: Finishing a dua, adhkar or reading session
prompt: A warm soft breeze rustling through palm fronds, clear leafy rustle that settles into calm, close and present, peaceful, natural, no music, no voice

name: wudu_reminder
prompt: Clean water flowing gently from a tap into a stone basin, calm and clear, short, close up, natural, no music

name: iftar
description: Water poured into a clay cup
use: Iftar time, fast completed, Ramadan countdown finished
prompt: Cool water poured into a clay cup with a few dates placed softly into a ceramic dish, calm and warm, close up, no music, no voice

name: suhoor_alarm
description: Early birds waking by a stream
use: Suhoor and tahajjud alarms, gentle wake-up
prompt: Early morning before dawn, a few soft bird calls waking up beside a gentle stream, calm and slowly brightening, natural, no music, no voice
